14 | Call Cold II | 20'x20'x20' | 1 rnd/lvl | 20' | E
15 | Ice Bolt V | 1 target | - | 500' | DE
16 | Triad of Ice | 3 targets | - | 10' | DE
18 | Call Cold V | 50'x50'x50' | 1 rnd/lvl | 100' | E
20 | Cold Ball IV | 40'R | - | 300' | BE
25 | Rain/Snow | 1 mi R | varies | self | E
30 | Cold True | 1000' R/lvl | 24 hr | self | E
50 | Cold Mastery | varies | 1 rnd/lvl | varies | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
For every level of the caster, 1 cubic foot of liquid is cooled to freezing at
a rate of one cubic foot per round. This will not drop a liquid’s temperature
below -20ºF (thus, liquids will a freezing point below -20ºF will not freeze).
@@ 2
Any solid, inanimate, non-metal material can be cooled to -20ºF, at a rate of
1 cubic foot per round of concentration.
@@ 3
Creates a clear wall of intense cold (up to 10'x10'x1'). Anyone passing
through this wall takes an 'A' Cold critical (no RR).
@@ 5
As Cool Solid, except material can be cooled to -200ºF, at a rate of 50ºF per
round. The caster must concentrate to decrease the temperature (without
concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the
duration of the spell).
@@ 6
A bolt of ice is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Ice
Bolt Attack Table 13.6 (p. 85).
@@ 7
A 1' diameter ball of cold is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching
its target, it explodes to affect a 20' radius area. Resolve the attack on the
Cold Ball Attack Table 13.3 (p. 82).
@@ 8
Summons a wall of ice up to 10'x10'x(2' at base, 1' at top). It can be melted
through or chipped through or toppled (if not against a solid surface).
@@ 9
As Wall of Cold, except it creates a cube of cold (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The
cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through
or that is caught inside the cube takes an 'A' Cold critical each round he is
inside.
@@ 10
As Wall of Cold, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 20' radius circle (6''
thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).
@@ 11
As Ice Bolt I, except range is 300'.
@@ 12
For every level of the caster, changes 10 cubic foot of water to ice,
instantly.
@@ 13
As Chill Solid, except chills metal to the point that it becomes extremely
brittle (1 object only). Under normal conditions, this will decrease a
weapon’s strength (when checking for breakage) by 50. In addition, the weapon
will have its breakage number increased by 5 (to a maximum of 10). Each
following minute the breakage factor will decrease by 1 until it returns to
normal (i.e., it warms up); also, the weapon’s strength will increase by 5
each minute until it returns to normal.
@@ 14
As Call Cold I, except size is up to a 20' cube and the range is 20'.
@@ 15
As Ice Bolt I, except range is 500'.
@@ 16
Three bolts of ice are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to
three different targets (as long as they are all withing 60º of each other;
and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill
(Icebolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB).
@@ 18
As Call Cold I, except size is up to a 50' cube and the range is 100'.
@@ 20
As Cold Ball II, except area of effect is 40' radius and the range is 300'.
@@ 25
Changes all rain within 1 mile of the caster to snow. The area of effect
decreases by 500' radius for every 10ºF above freezing.
@@ 30
Causes the temperature to drop 1ºF every 10 minutes up to a number of degrees
equal to the caster’s level.
@@ 50
Caster can use any one lower level spell (on this list) each round.
